DONE

I've built the three-tab workbook. In every month, the schedule balances agree with your GL balances for both accounts (variance $0.00 after rounding to cents). No spreadsheet app was available here, so I checked the formulas with a Python formula engine rather than opening the file in Excel.

| Account | Invoiced YTD | Amortization YTD | Ending balance 4/30/25 | GL 4/30/25 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prepaid Expenses (1250) | $1,087,156.21 | $527,778.60 | $559,377.61 | $559,377.61 |
| Prepaid Insurance (1251) | $568,698.22 | $198,721.52 | $369,976.70 | $369,976.70 |
| Total | $1,655,854.43 | $726,500.12 | $929,354.31 | $929,354.31 |

How I read the invoices:
- **Expenses:** None of the 41 expense invoices states a period, so each runs six months from its invoice month, with a full month taken in the first month. That treatment ties to the GL.
- **Good Insurance:** The 21 invoices run 12 months from January.
- **BCBS:** Each monthly invoice is held as prepaid and expensed the month after its date. The January invoice covers February, and the April invoice covers May. This is the only treatment that ties to the January GL balance, which includes the full January BCBS invoice.
- **Chart-of-accounts numbers:**
  - Expense accounts are mapped from the invoice descriptions: IT Services 6760, Subscription 6762, Technical Services Fee 7001, Building Maintenance 6020, Good Insurance 5400, BCBS 5015.
  - Advising went to 5720 Consulting Fees, which is my judgment because the chart has no exact match.
  - The chart lists expense accounts only, so 1250 and 1251 come from your assignment.
- **Vendor names:** I kept them as printed on the invoices. "ADOBE MAGENTO" and "Magento" are listed separately, so please confirm whether they are the same vendor.
- **Rounding:** Monthly expense is left unrounded in the formulas so the GL ties to the cent. A displayed total can differ from a manual sum of the visible cents by $0.01.
- **Tab names:** The expense and insurance tabs are named "Prepaid Expenses (1250)" and "Prepaid Insurance (1251)". Excel caps sheet names at 31 characters, and "Prepaid Expenses (Account #1250)" is 32.
- **Input folders:** `workspace/` and `attachments/` were empty, so I worked only from the PDFs and `COA.xlsx`.

These assumptions are also written on the Prepaid Summary tab.

Files are in `outputs/`:
- Aurisic_Prepaid_Amortization_Schedule_Apr2025.xlsx
